name: Zero-Downtime Migration from XML Export to JSON Stream
task_description: Execute a 4-phase Expand/Contract zero-downtime migration replacing legacy GET /v1/export.xml with paginated streaming JSON endpoint, issuing a deprecation notice and dual-write database adapter.
expected_stages: Expand Phase (Add New Endpoint & Dual Write)

guardrails.enforce_expand_contract_safety: Never break existing clients; enforce dual-write / backward-compatible deprecation window
guardrails.prohibit_destructive_schema_edits: Database migrations must support concurrent running application versions without locking tables
guardrails.enforce_surgical_diff: Keep migration adapters minimal and adhere strictly to YAGNI
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Record zero-downtime evolution lessons and telemetry thresholds in completion report

invariants: No breaking API change without backward-compatible deprecation window and sunset date
Database schema migration must support concurrent running versions without downtime
Contract verification passes before completion and telemetry verifies caller migration
Record migration rollback triggers and data consistency findings in completion report Section 5
